doors.name: Classroom door
doors.text: Plywood, painted with a sun and a row of handprints at child height.

doors.name: Archive door
doors.text: ARCHIVE - RECORDS, stencilled. Hollo keeps it shut so the paper stays dry.

doors.name: Clinic door
doors.text: Propped open. The warm air leaks out into the corridor and nobody minds.

props.name: Canteen table
props.text: Scrubbed pale. Meals are eaten in three shifts, and you sit where your shift sits.

props.name: The Exchange
props.text: Kasimir's counter at the old serving hatch. Thread, batteries, a jar of honey that is mostly water. Everything has a price in ration coupons, and the price moves.

props.name: Crate
props.text: Kasimir's stock. Padlocked.

props.name: Bench
props.text: By the radiator, the best seat in the commons.

props.name: Cooking range
props.text: Cast iron, older than anyone. It burns dried stalks from the bays when the hotplates are off.

props.name: Kitchen sinks
props.text: Warm water here twice a day, for washing pots, not hands.

props.name: Kitchen counter
props.text: Knives on chains. Someone has scratched a tally of meals into the steel.

props.name: Sacks
props.text: Potatoes and barley from the bays, weighed in, weighed out, signed for by Albu's clerk.

props.name: Shelves
props.text: Tins with no labels and a jar of salt counted by the spoon.

props.name: School desk
props.text: Initials carved through three generations of varnish.

props.name: Teacher's desk
props.text: Hollo's lesson plan, unchanged since the founders wrote it. Today: the core, and why we do not waste heat.

props.name: Archive shelves
props.text: Box files by year. Some years are thinner than others.

props.name: Back shelf
props.text: The last shelf against the wall. Behind the box files, wedged at the back, something hard and square wrapped in a rag.

props.name: Filing cabinet
props.text: Ration ledgers, decades of them. Names crossed out in different inks.

props.name: Filing cabinet
props.text: Admissions, 1952. The founders numbered the residents by trade.

props.name: Hollo's desk
props.text: A black pen, a red pen and a stack of files with strips of paper pasted over lines.

props.name: Washbasins
props.text: Bath day is posted on the door. It is not today.

props.name: Toilet stall
props.text: Working, mostly.

props.name: Ward bed
props.text: Clean sheets, boiled and dried on the clinic's own radiator.

props.name: Grigore's bed
props.text: Grigore's bed. Diagrams of the exchanger in pencil on the back of ration forms, under the pillow.

props.name: Screen
props.text: A folding screen. Privacy, of a kind.

props.name: Screen
props.text: A folding screen. Privacy, of a kind.

props.name: Medicine cabinet
props.text: Dr. Kiss's stock: aspirin cut in halves, iodine, a bottle of something brown with no label.

props.name: Medicine cabinet
props.text: Bandages washed and rolled for reuse.

props.name: Dr. Kiss's desk
props.text: The health-screening schedule. Every resident, every quarter, measured against a list nobody here wrote.

props.name: Waiting bench
props.text: Full. Half the people here are not ill; they are warm.

props.name: Waiting bench
props.text: Someone is asleep on it, coat over their head.

inspect.name: The screen
inspect.text: The commons screen. At set hours it plays Hollo's history of the silo: the founders, the Frostfall, the Council's wisdom. The rest of the time it is dark.

inspect.name: Ration board
inspect.text: Numbered portions, chalked weekly. Council members' portions are listed separately, at the bottom, in smaller writing.

inspect.name: Lift 2
inspect.text: OUT OF ORDER, sprayed across doors that have not opened in forty years. The shaft behind carries the cables now.

inspect.name: Notice board
inspect.text: Bath-day rota. Heat hours for the general circuit. A lost glove. A reminder that radiator keys are Council property.

inspect.name: Blackboard
inspect.text: THE CORE KEEPS US WARM, in Hollo's capitals, over a chalk drawing of the exchanger that is almost right.

inspect.name: Graffiti
inspect.text: HEAT IS RANK, in red crayon under the blackboard, at the height of a ten-year-old. Someone has tried to scrub it off and given up.

inspect.name: Radiator
inspect.text: Hot to the touch. The clinic is on the priority circuit, and everyone on this level knows it.

stairs.name: Dormitory wing
stairs.text: East, past the stairwell, to the dormitories.
